IfMatch.description: Strong quoted version from the endpoint's ETag, a comma-separated list of tags, or `*` (ADR-007).
IfMatch.name: If-Match

IfMatchNoWildcard.description: Strong quoted version from the endpoint's ETag, or a comma-separated list of tags. A lone `*` is rejected with 400 `invalid-precondition`.
IfMatchNoWildcard.name: If-Match

ForbiddenOrFeatureDisabled.description: `forbidden`: the caller lacks `webhook:manage`; or `feature-disabled`: webhooks are not enabled for the tenant (ADR-010 §3). `feature-disabled` carries `feature: webhooks`.

InvalidPrecondition.description: `invalid-precondition`: malformed or weak If-Match, or a malformed Idempotency-Key (`validation-error`).

NotFound.description: `not-found`: the resource is missing, deleted, or belongs to another tenant.

PreconditionFailed.description: `precondition-failed`. The response carries the current ETag and `current_version`.

UnprocessableUrlOrBody.description: `webhook-url-not-allowed` (pointer `/url`; the detail names the broken rule, never the resolved address), `validation-error` (for example pointer `/event_types/0` for an unknown type), or an Idempotency-Key reused with a different request.

ValidationError.description: `validation-error` for a malformed query parameter or cursor.

CloudEvent.description: The ADR 006 envelope. `data` is defined per type in `docs/events/asyncapi.yaml`.

EventType.description: A catalog type with `x-talentflow.webhook = true` in `docs/events/asyncapi.yaml`.

value.description: Shown only once. Store it in the receiver's secret store.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details, as described in `docs/api-errors.md`.

grace_period_seconds.description: How long the old secret keeps signing. 0 expires it immediately (use this after a leak).

previous_secret_expires_at.description: When the replaced secret stops signing. Equals the request time when the grace period is 0.

UpdateWebhookEndpointRequest.description: Partial update. `event_types` replaces the whole set. A new `url` applies to the next attempt of every pending delivery, retries included (ADR-008 §5).

kind.description: Set on creation and never changes. `redelivery` rows were created by an admin redelivery.

redelivery_of_id.description: Lineage of a `redelivery` row. It becomes null once retention purges the original; `kind` still identifies the row.

requested_by.description: Actor id for a manual redelivery.

WebhookDeliveryAttempt.description: Receiver response bodies and headers are never stored.

secrets.description: Metadata only. The secret value is never returned here.

status.description: Catalog status. `reserved` types can be subscribed to; they start flowing when their publisher ships.

WebhookUrl.description: Absolute `https` URL (`http` only when `WEBHOOK_ALLOW_HTTP` is set, which is never in production). No userinfo or fragment. Ports 443/8443 (https) or 80/8080 (http). Every resolved address must be public (ADR-008 §4).

bearerAuth.description: Keycloak access token. The web app calls the API through its BFF session (ADR 004).

Creates a new delivery of the same event, sent with the same `webhook-id`, the current secrets and a fresh attempt counter. The original delivery is never changed. Allowed only when the original is terminal and the endpoint is enabled. Idempotency-Key is supported.

202.description: The new delivery, queued for an immediate first attempt.

409.description: `delivery-not-redeliverable` (the original is not terminal, the endpoint is not enabled, or this event already has a pending delivery to this endpoint), or `conflict` while an Idempotency-Key reservation is in progress.

422.description: The Idempotency-Key was reused with a different request.

post.description: Requires If-Match with a concrete version. A lone `*` returns 400 `invalid-precondition`, because a wildcard would let a retried request rotate twice. Idempotency-Key is ignored because the response contains the new secret, so If-Match is what stops a double rotation. The current secret becomes `previous` until `grace_period_seconds` passes, and both sign meanwhile. An older `previous` expires at once.

get.description: Catalog types whose AsyncAPI entry has `x-talentflow.webhook = true`.

post.description:
One request per attempt. Signed content is `"{webhook-id}.{webhook-timestamp}." + raw body`,
HMAC-SHA256 with the decoded `whsec_` key, base64 encoded (Standard Webhooks `v1`).
Receivers verify the raw bytes, reject timestamps more than 300 s away from their own
clock, and deduplicate on `webhook-id`. A 2xx counts as success. Redirects are not followed.
410 Gone disables the endpoint. Any other result is retried (ADR-008 §5).

parameters.description: CloudEvents `id`. The same value on every retry and redelivery of the event.
parameters.name: webhook-id

parameters.description: Unix seconds when this attempt was signed.
parameters.name: webhook-timestamp

parameters.description: Space-separated `v1,<base64>` entries, one per active secret: current first, then previous during a rotation grace period.
parameters.name: webhook-signature

2XX.description: Accepted by the receiver. The body is discarded after at most 64 KiB.

410.description: Gone. The delivery is dead-lettered and the endpoint is auto-disabled (`gone`).

default.description: Failure. Retried on the ADR-008 schedule, up to 8 attempts.

post.summary: Outbound event request sent to a registered endpoint
